reader_summary.overview: Today we will be diving into Shopify. Shopify was founded in 2004 by Tobi Lütke and Scott Lake around their original problem of why it's so hard to build an online business when they struggled to open an online snowboard equipment store.. Today, Shopify's goal is to make commerce better for everyone and it's essentially an on-ramp for people looking to sell online.

key_points.text: Shopify was founded in 2004 by Tobi Lütke and Scott Lake around their original problem of why it's so hard to build an online business when they struggled to open an online snowboard equipment store..
To help us break down Shopify, I'm joined by co-host Zack Fuss and our guest Alex Danco.
To really understand Shopify, you have to understand its different business units -- Core, Merchant Services, Ecosystem.
